subject.title: feat(android): add Wear conversations, voice, agents, and sessions

question: Should OpenClaw ship an official bundled Wear OS conversation client that can read transcripts and control active agents and sessions, and if so, should this branch become the second stage after the status-only bridge?
rationale: The implementation expands the official mobile product, sensitive-data boundary, release surface, CI footprint, and persistent settings; correctness review cannot choose whether OpenClaw should own and distribute that product surface.

options.title: Sponsor the staged Wear client
options.body: Merge the status prerequisite first, require the license and CI fixes plus a release/privacy plan, then review this branch as the owner-approved interactive second stage.

options.title: Keep status-only scope
options.body: Land only the staged status bridge and defer conversations, transcript access, voice, agents, and sessions until a narrower product proposal is approved.

options.title: Decline bundled Wear support
options.body: Close both Wear branches if OpenClaw does not want to own a watch application, release artifact, and paired-device action boundary.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the staged Wear client
recommendation.body: Merge the status prerequisite first, require the license and CI fixes plus a release/privacy plan, then review this branch as the owner-approved interactive second stage.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository explicitly identifies @obviyus as the Android app owner, and this decision governs Android product scope and distribution.
